about_the_game:
The official report calls it "a minor pest problem"

They didn't mention the "pests" have overrun every last mile of the untamed wilds..

The frontier is impassable, the outlands are swarming, and someone needs to take out the trash. That someone is you. Forget heroes in shining armor; the world's only hope is a trucker with a powerful rig, a loose grasp on the concept of "road safety," and enough illegally-bolted-on firepower to level a mountain.

A Minor Pest Problem is a 2D top-down shooter where you get behind the wheel of your heavily armed truck to tame a savage wilderness. Blaze your own trail through dense forests and desolate wastelands, turning monstrous hordes into puddles of goo. Scrape up the... uh... "biological samples" they leave behind and use them to upgrade your truck from a simple hauler into the apex predator of the badlands.

The job is simple: drive, shoot, survive.

Key Features:

  • Intense Off-Road Carnage: Experience satisfyingly chaotic shoot-em-up action. Blast through ancient forests, drift across sand dunes, and forge a path of destruction through the wilderness.

  • Your Rig, Your Rules: Your truck is your weapon. Upgrade it with an absurd arsenal of roof-mounted guns, earth-shattering cannons, defensive armor, and gadgets built for the apocalypse.

  • A Menagerie of Monstrosities: Battle a diverse roster of "pests". From zombies to hulking guardians, learn their patterns and squash them flat.

  • The Wilderness Pays Well: Take on contracts to cull nests deep in the woods, chart dangerous territories, and recover lost equipment from the clutches of whatever has it.

  • Easy to Learn, Fun to Master: With intuitive controls, you'll be causing mayhem in minutes. But with deep upgrade paths and ever-escalating challenges, only the best exterminators will conquer the wild.

So grab your keys and load your shells. It's time to show these pests they picked the wrong territory to infest. After all, you've got a delivery to make.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRam, shader model 3.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: In "A Minor Pest Problem," Pilot a heavily armed truck through environments in this 2D top-down shooter. Prove that no problem is too big for a trucker with enough firepower. Drive, shoot, survive, and show the wilderness what a real pest looks like.
